subject: Visibility grid, onstage runbook, and demo cadence — contract details
body:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@summitco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Visibility grid + draft SOW for Redwood sponsorship at GridSummit 2027

Hi Mina,

Great to be in touch — excited to have Redwood as a Premier sponsor for GridSummit 2027. Attached are two items for your review: Sponsor_Visibility_Grid_v1.xlsx (high-level placement + impressions) and Draft_SOW_GridSummit_v1.pdf (scope + deliverables).

A few quick notes:
- We have penciled in one 30-minute demo pod (Day 2, 11:00 AM) and a 20-minute onstage tech spotlight (Day 3, 2:30 PM).
- Lead capture: we can integrate your lead form into our demo pod queue or provide CSV exports post-event (let us know your preference).
- Logo: primary hero logo (website + stage backdrop) will be due for sign-off 6 weeks prior to event for artwork prep.

Can you confirm: preferred demo cadence (single extended demo vs. three short rotations), whether you want the 20-min spotlight or a 10-min lightning slot, and any AV upgrade requests?

If useful I can draft a short amendment that nails speaker time and logo position once you confirm.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Partnerships Manager, GridSummit Events
Elena Soto | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachments: Sponsor_Visibility_Grid_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Draft_SOW_GridSummit_v1.pdf (pdf)

-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@summitco.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility grid + draft SOW for Redwood sponsorship at GridSummit 2027

Hi Elena — thanks for the materials and the clear summary. Quick responses below and a couple of asks before we move to a formal amendment: 

- Demo cadence: we prefer three 10-minute demos spread across Day 2 (AM / Midday / Late PM). That maximizes reach across time zones for our team.
- Spotlight length: we'd like the 20-minute tech spotlight, but can accept a 15-minute window if AV constraints require trimming.
- Lead capture: we want real-time integration into our CRM (HubSpot). Does your demo queue expose a webhook or API? If not, a 24-hour CSV export is OK but not ideal.
- Logo approval timeline: can you push the hero logo deadline to 5 weeks out? Our creative team is swamped this Q.
- AV upgrades: please include the pricing for a single camera feed + livestream (we may need it for the spotlight).

Attaching our logo package for your creative team: redwood_logo_pack.zip (includes SVG/PNG in primary/white variations).

If you can provide a revised visibility grid that maps to the three-demo cadence and calls out hero vs. supporting logo placement, we’ll push this through legal faster.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | (650) 555-0168
Attachment: redwood_logo_pack.zip (asset bundle)

-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@summitco.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Visibility grid + draft SOW for Redwood sponsorship at GridSummit 2027

Kimberly / Soojin — forwarding Elena's original with our replies and logo pack. Key asks from my side before I authorize legal to proceed: 

1) Primary logo placement: we should insist on hero placement on the stage backdrop and website hero slot (top center) in exchange for committing to the 20-min spotlight. If they push back, negotiate hero on stage + supporting on website.
2) Demo cadence: confirm three 10-min rotations (Day 2 AM / Midday / Late PM). Soojin, can you confirm which engineers we can allocate for those windows? We should avoid late PM if it's past 6pm PT.
3) Lead capture: ask events ops whether there is a webhook. If not, we accept 24-hour CSV but need guaranteed field mappings (email, company, title, session timestamp).
4) AV and livestream: push for single-camera livestream included (or discounted). If there's an upcharge, request price for camera + stream line-item only.
5) Timeline: request hero logo deadline to 5 weeks out.

Can one of you take point on each bullet? I’ll handle the contract-side language once they confirm the revised grid.

Thanks — Mina

-----
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@summitco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility grid + draft SOW for Redwood sponsorship at GridSummit 2027

Hi Mina / Kimberly / Soojin — thanks for the clear notes. Quick updates after speaking with production this morning: 

- Demo cadence: we can run three 10-minute demo rotations on Day 2 (confirmed windows: 10:30 AM, 1:15 PM, 4:00 PM). We've moved the Redwood demo pod earlier to avoid the 6 PM slot.
- Spotlight: we can extend to 20 minutes; production will reserve a single camera + livestream for the session. We will itemize the AV cost in the SOW but are prepared to cover 50% of the livestream fee as a courtesy.
- Lead capture: production exposes a webhook that can push attendee metadata to your endpoint (they will provide docs). If you prefer CSV fallback, they will also supply a field-mapped CSV within 24 hours post-event.
- Logo timeline: we can accept hero logo sign-off 5 weeks out — thanks for the heads up.

Attached are the revised Draft_SOW_GridSummit_v2.pdf and Visibility_Grid_v2.xlsx reflecting the three-demo cadence, hero placement, and the 50% livestream concession. HubSpot link and DocuSign envelope below for your contracts team.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/details/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If all looks good I’ll route the SOW to your legal and button up dates for the speaker rehearsal.

Best,
Elena Soto
Partnerships Manager | GridSummit Events
Attachments: Draft_SOW_GridSummit_v2.pdf (pdf), Visibility_Grid_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
